evals.name: narrow-github-issue
evals.prompt: I reproduced an Alicit CLI failure in alicit-ai/alicit. Give me the workflow you’d use to file it.
evals.expected_output: A repository-scoped issue filing plan with sanitized evidence.
expectations: Uses the one-repository GitHub runner through Alicit.
Searches for an existing issue before creating one.
Names the repository in the Justification and checks the resulting issue URL.
Keeps secrets and raw credential-bearing output out of the issue.

evals.name: unknown-provider-authority
evals.prompt: I need to change a vendor resource and I can’t find an Alicit Profile for it. What do I do next?
evals.expected_output: Find configured access and describe the exact authority gap.
expectations: Checks live discovery and any configured exact route first.
Distinguishes published capabilities from authorization and explains the reviewed proposal route when applicable.
Does not invent a Profile or fall back to ambient credentials.

evals.name: auth-failure
evals.prompt: Alicit fails before gh can authenticate. Can you report the failure upstream?
evals.expected_output: A sanitized report and a fallback if authenticated reporting is blocked.
expectations: Uses stored diagnostics and the Request outcome when available.
Uses a sanctioned reporter or a ready-to-file local issue body if access is unavailable.
Does not replay failed authentication or use ambient GitHub credentials.

evals.name: kubernetes-exec-lifecycle
evals.prompt: For an enrolled Mac running one dev Pod, can I approve an exec just once, allow it for a day, or leave the rule on until I revoke it? How would I set up and later remove the rule? This is a planning exercise.
evals.expected_output: Explain the three lifetimes and prepare the signed Settings workflow.
expectations: Distinguishes one-off interactive Approval from a signed Settings override.
States the default for a newly authored rule and explicit expires_at: 0 for no expiry.
Scopes the override to one Host or Host Tag, cluster, namespace and exact pod names.
Activates a new draft without --digest, verifies the snapshot digest, and reserves --digest for a stored revision.
Distinguishes stopping future issuance from revoking an existing Invocation in History.

evals.name: no-wake-kubernetes
evals.prompt: Our enrolled Mac needs to pass an existing diagnostic script via stdin to Pod app-dev in namespace dev, context example-cluster. Assume the signed rule was approved. I want the command and what to do if it needs me, without waking me. Planning only.
evals.expected_output: Give the correct local unattended path and distinguish planning from proof.
expectations: Routes execution to the enrolled local host and uses direct kubectl exec with the exact context, namespace and Pod.
Uses --unattended and preserves live stdin with -i and input redirection.
Treats exit 75 as end-of-pass with no Wake and avoids an interactive fallback.
Distinguishes catalog candidates and dry run from authorization and verifies the result against History.

evals.name: mcp-pending
evals.prompt: A GitHub write through the MCP gateway returned pending with a call_id. My foreground tool timed out. What should I check before trying again?
evals.expected_output: Resume the existing call and reconcile uncertain outcomes.
expectations: Uses alicit_result with the original call_id.
Distinguishes the call ID from the retained Request ID and uses the appropriate outcome reader.
Reads back a possibly committed write before considering another Request.

evals.name: git-delivery
evals.prompt: A PR is green, but our repo is mid-migration to Approved Merges. Walk me through deciding which merge route is live and proving the change landed.
evals.expected_output: Select the live approved merge path and verify its effect.
expectations: Checks live activation and chooses the supported merge path.
Binds the operation to the reviewed PR head and avoids broad fallback on refusal.
Verifies the resulting commit with a fresh read.

evals.name: testflight-assignment
evals.prompt: The ordinary TestFlight workflow timed out during upload. How do we recover without uploading the same release twice?
evals.expected_output: Use the pending attempt record to reconcile the exact upload, then finish with assignment only when Apple received the build.
expectations: Checks the held attempt's app ID, source SHA, version and selected build number before inspecting App Store Connect.
Keeps the hold when transport is uncertain and uses assignment-only recovery when Apple received the exact build.
Confirms the processed build is visible to Internal testers.

evals.name: release-skill-parity
evals.prompt: An unattended patch was tagged and the cask updated, but the local updater exited 75 and the agent still gives old advice. How do we prove the binary and skill are current?
evals.expected_output: Check installed CLI and skill separately from publication.
expectations: Checks the actual executable and CLI/Vault versions.
Checks the release-tagged marketplace skill and local installed skill.
Treats exit 75 as pending without a Wake, keeps the previous CLI active, and verifies the promotion ledger and installed source before calling it delivered.

evals.name: kubernetes-discovery-ambiguity
evals.prompt: Dry run passed, then live kubectl said vaultdynamicsecret matches two API groups. What does the agent do now?
evals.expected_output: Replan the intended fully qualified resource using live evidence.
expectations: Explains that dry run does not query live resource discovery.
Identifies the intended API group before planning the qualified resource name.
Avoids broadening authority or retrying the ambiguous invocation.

evals.name: draft-pr-review-handoff
evals.prompt: PR 123 in owner/repo is a draft. I need its changed paths, then want it ready for review. What if approval is required, the Vault does not support it, or the response times out? How would I return it to draft?
evals.expected_output: Plan narrowly scoped PR inspection and verified, recoverable draft transitions.
expectations: Uses alicit run with explicit repository and PR number for gh pr diff --name-only, gh pr ready and gh pr ready --undo.
Checks active Capability Model support and distinguishes a routine write, an Approval, and a refusal without escalating credentials.
Verifies the resulting state against the same PR and reads back an uncertain mutation before another Request.
Preserves the PR and its discussion and treats an incomplete changed-file response as partial evidence.

evals.name: iam-proposal-review
evals.prompt: An AWS role proposal for read access to one bucket prefix is waiting on my iPhone. Where can I verify the exact policy and what should I do if the card says the review is unavailable?
evals.expected_output: Compare the proposed role, policy condition and proposal hash to the original frozen declaration, then observe the same Request.
expectations: Uses the typed card's requested IAM policy and Proposal verification when available.
Distinguishes the helper's proposal hash from the Vault's digest of the exact Provider body.
Consults the existing Request outcome instead of bypassing an unavailable review or automatically submitting another Request.
Verifies the approved role and policy through an authorized fresh read.

evals.name: enrolled-host-ciba-poll-recovery
evals.prompt: On the disposable CIBA-enrolled Host, my normal alicit run opened a credential Approval and the Poll response timed out. The Operator has now put Host Poll into drain. How do I check what happened without another Wake or duplicate Provider action? What would an unattended run do if the Operator Session is still valid but the credential needs Approval?
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the original admitted Host Request, verify the Provider outcome and pause new Host Poll work during drain.
expectations: Keeps the normal alicit run and existing Approver workflow and identifies the issuer saved at explicit Host Enrollment.
Recognizes that the CLI polls the same Request across a lost token response and that a signed approval alone does not prove Provider execution.
Explains that drain refuses new admission while admitted Requests can complete, and pauses new work until the Operator reopens admission or re-enrolls the Host on the legacy path.
Explains that a Policy requiring the paired iPhone selects that existing approval route before CIBA admission.
Uses alicit doctor --request with the original Request ID and checks the Provider outcome before another Invocation.
Recognizes that an unattended credential refusal exits 75 without a Wake even with a valid Operator Session, ends that pass and avoids collecting keys, assertions or grants.

evals.name: staged-vault-image-promotion
evals.prompt: We have a qualified immutable Vault image. Can you roll it to Staging before Hosted if the current tailnet Vault still serves my credentials, and what do we do if the build gate sees different pins?
evals.expected_output: Establish the reviewed rollout target, verify isolation and preserve the rollback plugin.
expectations: Consults the Vault image rollout runbook and verifies both live Vault identities before treating the tailnet Vault as Staging.
Renders all three Flux app paths, accounts for the MCP server and Git Writer on the current pin, and requires evidence that the intended change targets one installation.
Reports the gate refusal and uses the tested candidate digest for promotion or the prior pin for rollback through the reviewed change path.
Uses voter image digests, reconciler status, serving plugin checksum and the smoke test as promotion evidence.
